speaker.jigoku_pilot: Zeon remnant army grunt pilot (serving under Major Yonem Kirks)
speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Calls Noriko-type senior "Big Sis" (お姉さま), refers to herself as ノノ, Buster Machine 7 / Nonoriri / Tycho / Dix-Neuf lines; not a Zeon grunt

proposed_by_v_g010_00.basis: Calls Noriko-type senior "Big Sis" (お姉さま), refers to herself as ノノ, Buster Machine 7 / Nonoriri / Tycho / Dix-Neuf lines; not a Zeon grunt

proposed_by_v_g010_01.basis: Refers to herself as Nono, calls Noriko/Lal'C-type 'Big Sis' (お姉さま), mentions Nonoriri, Nicola, Dix-Neuf, Physical Reactor, Buster Machine No. 7 self-introduction, Strategy Class gag; Jigoku's Yonem Kirks identification is wrong

proposed_by_v_g010_02.basis: Nono: refers to herself as ノノ, calls Noriko/Nicola by name, Big Sis (お姉さま), Buster Machine 7 / Buster Legion / Lightning Kick lines; combo rows 10:10526-10796 (ノノ called by name, 'let's go 7') are Noriko's voice ($$ノリコ$$). Jigoku's Zeon grunt is wrong.

10:0.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will be like Big Sis too...!」

10:39.en: 「To be a true champion of justice...!」

10:76.en: 「Now $$ノノ$$ has become a $$バスターマシン$$\nin both heart and body!」

10:137.en: 「Now I can understand\n$$ノノリリ$$'s feelings!」

10:186.en: 「The bond with Big Sis\nis the source of $$ノノ$$'s power!」

10:235.en: 「This power exists\nto protect the people I love!」

10:321.en: 「Now is the time to show\n$$バスターマシン$$ power!」

10:370.en: 「Protecting Big Sis...!\nProtecting everyone is $$ノノ$$'s duty!」

10:427.en: 「Hard work and guts!\nThat's the power of $$バスターマシン$$s!」

10:484.en: 「I don't fight to defeat anything...!\nI fight to protect something!」

10:555.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will do what a\n$$バスターマシン$$ must do!」

10:612.en: 「$$ノノリリ$$, Big Sis...!\nPlease share your courage with $$ノノ$$!」

10:716.en: 「True power dwells only in those\nwho trust their strength to the end!」

10:865.en: 「Hopes passed down from ages past...!\nI'll protect them!」

10:924.en: 「The Earth $$ノノリリ$$ protected...!\nNext, $$ノノ$$ will protect it!」

10:979.en: 「Earth, my promised place with Big Sis!\nI'll definitely protect it!」

10:1075.en: 「Can't down it in one? Once more!」

10:1114.en: 「$$タイタン変動重力源$$! Prepare yourself!」

10:1198.en: 「The fight with the $$宇宙怪獣$$\nends here!」

10:1249.en: 「$$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$!\nNow is the time to settle this!」

10:1302.en: 「If space monsters are our bane,\nthen $$ノノ$$ is theirs!」

10:1363.en: 「Guard humanity from space monsters...!\nThat is $$ノノ$$'s mission!」

10:1422.en: 「I remember now\nwho I'm truly meant to fight!」

10:1477.en: 「Enemies of humanity, Angels too, are $$ノノ$$'s!」

10:1520.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will fight the despair shards\nthat the $$アンチスパイラル$$ left!」

10:1585.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will stop the unit's movement!」

10:1661.en: 「Machines have hearts too,\nand you mustn't lose yours!」

10:1718.en: 「$$ノノ$$, a machine like you,\nwill teach you a heart of justice!」

10:1771.en: 「I'll release you from\nthe Lieutenant Colonel's will!」

10:1879.en: 「$$ノノ$$'s enemy is the fighting itself!」

10:1920.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will fight anything that comes\nto Earth with malice!」

10:2114.en: 「$$バスターマシン$$s are the swords\nof those without power!」

10:2169.en: 「$$バスターマシン$$s fight anything\nthat threatens humanity!」

10:2222.en: 「Whoever you are,\nI will carry justice through!」

10:2273.en: 「An ideal won by war has no justice!」

10:2314.en: 「I'll defeat the root of evil here!」

10:2347.en: 「Humanity has the will and resolve\nto fight!」

10:2396.en: 「For peace, $$ノノ$$ fights to the end!」

10:2439.en: 「Hard work and guts make up for size!」

10:2482.en: 「Strength isn't about body size!\nIt's the power of the heart!」

10:2541.en: 「The $$ノノ$$ of now\ncan keep up with that speed!」

10:2629.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$ are foes of all humanity!」

10:2670.en: 「I'll face a $$スフィア・リアクター$$\nwith a Physical Reactor!」

10:2741.en: 「$$スフィア$$s aren't a power meant\nto be used for such things!」

10:2804.en: 「$$アウストラリス$$!\nYour days as emperor end today!」

10:2861.en: 「You and $$ノノ$$!\n$$次元獣$$ vs. $$バスター軍団$$!」

10:2918.en: 「Even if you live for eternity,\nyou must never lose your heart!」

10:2977.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will break through\nthe darkness in your heart!」

10:3030.en: 「$$バスターマシン$$s fight everything\nthat steals humanity's future!」

10:3089.en: 「You who steal the future and hope\naren't emissaries of God!」

10:3158.en: 「The goddess of victory won't smile\non those who fight only in anger!」

10:3211.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will never accept\nwhat you think is fun!」

10:3268.en: 「True joy belongs not to one person,\nbut is something to be shared!」

10:3333.en: 「Your joy is something\nonly you can rejoice in!」

10:3386.en: 「$$ノノ$$ won't accept a person who\nsmilingly makes others sacrifice!」

10:3447.en: 「For every world's future and peace,\n$$ノノ$$ will defeat you!」

10:3512.en: 「You should trust not the $$御使い$$s,\nbut yourselves!」

10:3573.en: 「You are people who threw away\nthe future to survive!」

10:3923.en: 「$$バスターマシン$$ proof! Buster Beam!」

10:4138.en: 「With this... I cut you in two!!」

10:4549.en: 「$$バスターマシン７号$$, on the scene!」

10:4636.en: 「$$バスター軍団$$, all units, charge!」

10:4864.en: 「$$バスターマシン$$s don't\njust stay down after being hit!」

10:5022.en: 「Big Sis gave me this chance,\nand I can't waste it!」

10:5077.en: 「$$ディスヌフ$$! $$ノノ$$ is going too!」

10:5198.en: 「With $$ガンバスター$$ here,\n$$ノノ$$ can become a flame too!」

10:5251.en: 「At last I fight with $$ノノリリ$$...!」

10:5292.en: 「Add Buster Machine power\nto the EVA, and...!」

10:5341.en: 「On top of $$大グレン団$$'s spirit,\nI'll add hard work and guts!」

10:5396.en: 「Friendship between machines\nlights a fire in $$ノノ$$'s heart!」

10:5494.en: 「To guard my friends... here I go!」

10:5574.en: 「$$ノノ$$ is a $$フラタニティ$$ member too!\nI'll protect you!」

10:5629.en: 「Remember? We help each\nother out when in trouble!」

10:5723.en: 「Like you protect others, $$チコ$$,\n$$ノノ$$ will protect you!」

10:5878.en: 「$$ノリコ$$!\nLet's fight together to the end!」

10:5962.en: 「I can't afford to lose\n$$グレンラガン$$ here!」

10:6075.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will take this one on!」

10:6112.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will split the enemy up!」

10:6271.en: 「Please aim for the gap $$ノノ$$ makes!」

10:6308.en: 「If I can't counterattack,\nI'll make myself able to!」

10:6363.en: 「All I can do now is endure...!\nBut a chance will surely come!」

10:6479.en: 「I won't let myself be put\nout of action like this!」

10:6532.en: 「Ugh! That range is my weak spot...!」

10:6575.en: 「This is bad...!\nIn this spot I can only take hits!」

10:6632.en: 「Focus on dodging, and it's a breeze!」

10:6706.en: 「Looks like I managed to shake them!」

10:6739.en: 「I'll dodge as often as it takes!」

10:6862.en: 「I'll float like a butterfly,\nand sting like a bee!」

10:6913.en: 「I can turn on a dime now!」

10:6950.en: 「It's not that easy to hit me!」

10:6985.en: 「I won't let this scarf get damaged!」

10:7071.en: 「I'm fine now, but we must take care\nnot to get surrounded...!」

10:7128.en: 「With past data included, I grasp the\nstrength of the space monsters!」

10:7306.en: 「If I rewrite the laws of physics,\nthere's no problem!」

10:7433.en: 「Attacks like that don't work on me!」

10:7462.en: 「Hard work and guts...!\nThis is the invincible tag team!」

10:7511.en: 「A wound this minor\ndoesn't even need repairing!」

10:7669.en: 「$$ノノ$$'s soft skin is no pushover!」

10:7755.en: 「Small, but no one beats my guts!」

10:7794.en: 「I won't lose...!\nNot while I have hard work and guts!」

10:7894.en: 「A heart that won't break...\nThat's what makes $$ノノ$$ strong!」

10:7943.en: 「This is when the Buster Machine's\ntrue worth is put to the test!」

10:8004.en: 「As long as people believe in us,\nthe Buster Machine will never lose!」

10:8067.en: 「Hope on my back, guts in my chest!\nAnd a smile on my lips!」

10:8142.en: 「If you're afraid of pain, you can't\nbecome a true Top...!」

10:8199.en: 「Just like $$ディスヌフ$$!\nScars are the badge of a warrior!」

10:8254.en: 「On the name of the Solar System\nAbsolute Defense System...!」

10:8305.en: 「While we keep fighting, please\nrebuild and repair damaged parts!」

10:8425.en: 「On the Buster Machine's pride,\nI can't lose!」

10:8482.en: 「No matter what happens,\nI'll keep my promise to Big Sis...!」

10:8537.en: 「The Buster Machine never gives up\non victory until the very end...!」

10:8596.en: 「For those I must protect,\nI'll stand up again and again!」

10:8651.en: 「If you never quit, even in a pinch,\nthe road to victory opens!」

10:8720.en: 「The miracle $$ノノリリ$$ caused...!\n$$ノノ$$ will make one happen!」

10:8779.en: 「No matter how much damage I take,\nmy heart will never break!」

10:8838.en: 「Even a nanomachine body\nhas its limits, it seems...!」

10:8891.en: 「Even if I'm shaking with fear,\nthinking of Big Sis lets me fight!」

10:9031.en: 「$$ノノ$$... has stained the name of\n$$地球帝国宇宙軍$$...」

10:9227.en: 「$$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ Solar System Direct Cover Unit, Sixth-Generation Interstellar Decisive Battle Weapon, $$バスターマシン７号$$!」

10:9314.en: 「And then...! $$ノノ$$ was truly a fool!」

10:9410.en: 「Anyone who thinks 'if only I had a Buster Machine' can never be a true Top! Because...!」

10:9511.en: 「True power is with those who trust themselves to the end!」

10:9572.en: 「Surely, a real Buster Machine pilot...! A real $$ノノリリ$$...!」

10:9643.en: 「Because they carry a Buster Machine in their hearts!!」

10:9777.en: 「It's me and Big Sis's bond power!!」

10:9846.en: 「Big Sis and I are an invincible duo!」

10:10033.en: 「Big Sis! Let's do a Strategy Class too! Because! The famous $$ノノリリ$$ Strategy Class saved countless players with limitless knowledge!」

10:10526.en: 「$$ノノ$$, we bet it all on this blow!」

10:10569.en: 「Strength is the power of the heart!\n$$ノノ$$, that's hard work and guts!」
